title: SoulMaker character config schema v0.1
description: Shared declarative character config (features/02, features/09): the same schema powers player, NPC and enemy — config is the source of truth. Only format_version is required: a missing/absent optional field falls back to a default at load (graceful fallback, missing asset → default, never an error — ADR-009). Leaf objects tolerate unknown fields.

skeleton_profile.description: Standard humanoid skeleton (ADR-006), shared animation ecosystem.

morphs.description: Morph map {shape: value} — bounded blend shapes, linked slider groups enforced at editor + import.

attachments.description: 3D overlays bound to canonical rig sockets (features/02): armor pieces (helmet/chest/gauntlets/leggings — the armor overlay layer), hair, ears, cape, held items; runtime equipment references the same slots.

face.description: 2D anime face: texture-based detail over geometry morphs (features/02, ADR-019).

talk_poses.description: Bounded talk-loop pose set (features/02; speech is text-only, no visemes — 13/09/2026).

outfit.description: Clothing layer (features/02): the painted, fitted base look — texture set on the body mesh. Cosmetic (0 stats, 0 weight); default for the run's clothing slot, swappable in-game.

texture_set.description: Catalog clothing id (texture set sharing the frozen base UV layout).

role.description: Optional per-role extension. Same base mesh/morphs; only the role block differs.

enemy.description: Enemy config (features/05): archetype + boss marker + bounded stat multipliers + resist table.

boss_level.description: V1 boss marker: bounded stat multipliers only, no phases.

resist_table.description: Bounded resist multipliers for the 7 damage types (features/17).

npc.description: Dialogue link handled by the narrative layer (features/08).
